title: Trianglelab MZE w/sock
author: Robert Samples
licence_source: owner's screenshot of the Printables page, 2026-11-20 (Printables refuses automated reads); the remixed original (Printables 1263324, Bolado) is CC0 too
notes: A remix of 'MZE DLC V6 Melt Zone Extender' by Bolado (https://www.printables.com/model/1263324-mze-dlc-v6-melt-zone-extender): 'Corrected some minor dimensions, modeled silicone sock'.
An assembly of three solids, MZE, V6 nozzle and Sock, placed as fitted (the MZE's shoulder at Z 0, its M6 stud up). lite73_dav.py (vt350#263) hangs it under each toolhead's heat block stand-in.
Chosen because the owner's own Dragon ACE Volcano has an MZE of this shape (owner, 2026-11-20). Moved here from cad/vendor/ (cad/library/README.md, decision 3).
